purpose: Human-editable trainer difficulty, boss roster and route-population rules. Run generate_trainers.py after editing.

knobs.boss_level_offsets: Per-member offsets from each configured ace.
knobs.member_counts: Length of each boss members array and route archetype member_count.
knobs.ai: ai_profiles values; maxSelectMargin must stay positive.
knobs.route_density: Route placements arrays; coordinates must remain existing polyline vertices.

bosses.name: Brock
bosses.strategy: Geodude establishes rocks and speed control; Cranidos breaks; Onix converts a super-effective hit into a Weakness Policy counterattack.
bosses.ace_math_change: Sturdy guarantees one action; Weakness Policy turns the expected Water or Grass hit into a damage race.

bosses.name: Misty
bosses.strategy: Horsea starts rain; Lombre exploits it; Lightning Rod Goldeen disrupts a single Electric sweep; Starmie closes with broad special coverage.
bosses.ace_math_change: Life Orb makes Starmie's neutral coverage materially stronger while rain changes Water damage and turn order.

bosses.name: Lt. Surge
bosses.strategy: Electabuzz establishes paralysis and a screen; Magnezone pivots; Boltund attacks the resistance core; Air Balloon Raichu denies the first Ground line.
bosses.ace_math_change: Air Balloon forces the player to spend a turn breaking the ace's Ground immunity before cashing in the route's main answer.

availability_contract.failure: Only Bunnelby/Diggersby is a dependable ambient Ground family; the proposed Route 2 Geodude quarry is not implemented.

bosses.name: Erika
bosses.strategy: Bellossom starts sun and sleep pressure; Roserade lays hazards; Victreebel breaks under sun; Coba Berry Vileplume survives one Flying answer and sets up.
bosses.ace_math_change: Coba Berry removes the certainty of a one-hit Flying knockout and gives Growth a plausible opening.

bosses.name: Koga
bosses.strategy: Crobat creates Tailwind; Weezing blocks easy Ground lines; Drapion lays poison hazards; Toxtricity breaks; Venomoth snowballs through Tinted Lens.
bosses.ace_math_change: Tinted Lens makes normal Bug resists unreliable after Quiver Dance, demanding speed control or priority rather than type alone.

bosses.name: Sabrina
bosses.strategy: Hatterene reverses speed with Trick Room; Mr. Mime disrupts; Bronzong sustains the room; Rapidash breaks; Magic Guard Alakazam ignores passive damage.
bosses.ace_math_change: Magic Guard removes Life Orb recoil, so Alakazam gets the damage increase without the usual clock.

availability_contract.failure: A second broad answer depends on the unproven haunted-mansion Habitat; do not count it until runtime-proven.

bosses.name: Blaine
bosses.strategy: Drought Torkoal sets hazards and sun; Arcanine pressures physical answers; Magcargo punishes passivity; Magmortar and Typhlosion break; Charizard exploits sun.
bosses.ace_math_change: Solar Power plus sun changes damage thresholds, while Power Herb lets Charizard fire one immediate Solar Beam even if weather is displaced.

bosses.name: Giovanni
bosses.strategy: Roster intentionally withheld until the singles-versus-doubles decision is settled.

bosses.name: Lorelei
bosses.strategy: Snow, hazards and speed denial make resource preservation matter across the whole fight.
bosses.ace_math_change: Assault Vest turns Lapras into a special sponge while Freeze-Dry reverses the usual Water counter.

bosses.name: Bruno
bosses.strategy: Fake Out, removal, priority and mixed physical pressure punish a team that reaches the League without tempo tools.
bosses.ace_math_change: White Herb restores the defense drops from Close Combat and consumes itself to activate Unburden.

bosses.name: Agatha
bosses.strategy: Burns, Taunt, Trick and priority deny clean setup and force the player to manage status across six different Ghost patterns.
bosses.ace_math_change: Focus Sash guarantees Gengar a response and makes priority or prior hazard control part of the answer.

bosses.name: Lance
bosses.strategy: Aerodactyl sets the pace, each midgame member attacks a different Dragon answer, and Dragonite is the only dedicated setup closer.
bosses.ace_math_change: Multiscale plus Weakness Policy punishes an undisciplined super-effective first hit and changes priority damage thresholds.

bosses.name: Blue
bosses.strategy: Blue recombines the campaign's lessons: tempo lead, sleep, hazards, Intimidate, speed, and a setup ace with no single type shortcut.
bosses.ace_math_change: White Herb erases Shell Smash's defensive cost, forcing the player to stop the setup or answer a full-speed mixed-coverage closer.

player_team_snapshots.fairness: Multiple common Water/Grass answers; players can still bring neutral utility.
Electric and Grass families are both present before the lake gym.
One dependable immunity core exists; a second broad Ground family is missing.
Independent Flying, Ice and Fire lines exist.
Split Electric/Psychic/Ground offense answers Koga's immunity coverage.
One ambient Dark/Steel/Bug plan exists; mansion Ghosts remain optional and unproven.
Water, Ground and Rock answers are independently established.
Availability is broad, but fairness cannot be judged until Giovanni's format and roster are decided.
